content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target).**

- **§ 19.1** already warrants professional/workmanlike Services and Services/Deliverables conformance to documentation with no time limit; **§ 19.4** already gives re-performance, repair or replacement and a refund of Fees paid — so three of the four fallback elements are met verbatim.
- **§ 19.2** is the failure: a fifteen-day Deliverable conformance window with an express cut-off of any correction or refund obligation thereafter, below the 90-day software floor (and, on a broad reading of that cut-off, capping the remedy generally).
- **§ 19.5** does not swallow the express warranties (it preserves them), and §§ 6.1–6.2 are acceptance, not warranty, mechanics.
- Single surgical edit: "fifteen days" → "ninety days", plus "and any software delivered to Customer", preserving the rest of § 19.2 verbatim and the § 19.4 cross-reference. Preferred-level extras (12-month software period; § 19.3's "intentionally introduced by Vendor" narrowing) noted in the rationale only.
